purpose: Map the Android Termux operator path without substituting it for the still-separate Android profile launcher contract.

directories.purpose: Canonical repository-wide harness contracts and Android profile reservation.
Android Termux map, manifest, workflows, fixtures, report and artifact contracts.
Opt-in Android-local validation hooks; never installed implicitly.
Portable dependency-free structural contracts runnable in Termux and CI.
Human operator guidance, gaps, recovery and proof ceilings.
Hosted cross-platform validation for the harness change.

commands.termuxBootstrap: pkg update -y && pkg upgrade -y && pkg install -y git openssh tmux gh curl jq nano
commands.build: none; this lane contains harness contracts, not a compiled Android product
commands.deploy: none; Android profile launcher implementation and deployment remain out of scope

knownTraps: Do not treat the F-Droid or Termux installation alone as AgentSwitchboard Android runtime proof.
Do not store a Git working tree in Android shared storage when Termux home is available; shared storage can break Unix permission and symlink expectations.
Do not reinstall gh merely because a pasted command begins with literal [200~; prove command resolution with command -v gh and gh --version first.
Do not paste OAuth device codes, access tokens, private SSH keys, recovery codes or customer data into reports or chat.
Do not claim the Android profile launcher is implemented while the canonical registry remains reserved.
Do not install hooks implicitly; invoke the repository-owned hook explicitly when desired.
proofCeiling: Repository map and deterministic harness contracts only; no Android launcher, GitHub credential, clone, provider, agent-runtime or product-runtime proof.
